Subject: Brenvale Grill Holdings - Quote in Progress

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the submission on Brenvale Grill Holdings! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I have the application, statement of values, and loss runs—appreciate having a complete submission upfront. With 2 locations and $5.3M in total insured value, this fits well within our appetite for restaurant risks.

I'll work on putting together competitive terms for the December 4, 2026 effective date and should have something back to you within the next few days.

Please let me know if you have any questions in the meantime.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
